# #2797: Patch: card animations for Stinkyscape, part one: stinkyscape-001 to stinkyscape-090
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## What it does

This part fills in the first half of Stinkyscape's card animation table for #2782. That half is `apps/web/src/fx/cards/stinkyscape-1.json5`, covering `stinkyscape-001` to `stinkyscape-090`, in #2784's per-set layout.

Stinkyscape is the largest set: 178 cards and 52 tokens. It has 80 Spells, Field Spells, Traps or Field Traps (17 of them Field Spells) and 71 Units with a Cry, Death, trigger or Activate. It is split in two so its halves can be built in parallel. The second half has its own sub-issue of #2782. Its 92 Tech cards are why #2792 adds Tech sub-looks, `rocket` among them.

**The table split.** If #2784 merged one `stinkyscape.json5`, split it into `stinkyscape-1.json5` (001–090) and `stinkyscape-2.json5` (091 to the end) in this part's first commit, with the loader and the totality test reading both. Whichever half starts first does the split.

Read `docs/polish/9-card-animations.md`, and the "A task over every card" section of `docs/issues-and-patches.md`, first. This is a pass over every card.

### The measure

- **Spells and Traps:** every Spell, Field Spell, Trap and Field Trap in the range gets a motif, or a bespoke key, on its `cast` hook.
- **Units with a hook:** every Unit whose Cry, Death, trigger or Activate changes the board gets a motif on that hook.
- **Field Spells:** every Field Spell also gets an `aura` entry.
- **Vanilla Units and tokens:** a vanilla Unit may be `"none: vanilla"`. A token in this range gets an entry only where it earns one.
- **Choosing a motif:**
  - Pick from `cargo jackioh fx census` (#2788), never by comparing card texts, and give a reason for any override.
  - Use the Tech sub-looks (#2792) so the Tech cards don't blur into one look.
  - Set the scale from the card's cost and rarity.
- **Starship pieces:** leave the Starship's own moments (fuse, launch, the Launcher units) to the Starship part of #2782. A Starship Piece's other hooks still get entries here.
- **Bespoke:** 3 to 6 Flourishes, built from motif primitives, each with a one-line reason.
- **Legendary and Mythic entrances:** #2722's entrance and takeover animations are open to change (#2782); the owner finds them weak. A Legendary's or Mythic's Flourish may restyle its own entrance, and a Mythic its own takeover look, where the shared one doesn't suit the card. Do it through this set's table and its `fx/cards/<set>/` recipes; the shared takeover and the shared Legendary entrance in `fx/takeover.ts` are #2803's to rework. Keep the music (R2722000), when and for whom an entrance plays (R2722002) and the one capped hold (R2722001, as #2785 generalizes it). Update the tests that pin what you change, and amend R2722001 in this part's ruling note.
- **New motifs:** if 3 or more cards fit none, add one by the doc's rule. Coordinate with part two by naming it in the doc's table first.
- **Set pieces:** list any candidates in the PR, with a motif for now.

### The deliverable

A table in the PR with one row per card in the range. Each row gives the card's id and name, each hook's motif, palette and scale (or its key or `none` reason), the census suggestion, and why.

## Acceptance

- [ ] At least 55% of the range's cards have an entry other than `none`, and every Spell, Field Spell, Trap and Field Trap has a `cast` entry. A test enforces both on this file.
- [ ] Every Field Spell in the range has an `aura` entry.
- [ ] 3 to 6 bespoke Flourishes, each with a vitest and an R200 check.
- [ ] The PR's per-card table covers every card in the range.
- [ ] The table split, if this part made it, keeps the totality test over the whole set.
- [ ] No hidden card keys an entry (R202).
- [ ] The `/dev/fx` gallery plays every entry.
- [ ] Every number is a named constant (CLAUDE.md rule 9).
- [ ] Web typecheck, tests and eslint pass, and the hotseat smoke settles.

Blocked by #2786, #2788, #2783 and #2792. Part of #2782.
